adaptations: Integer Random.Range uses a controlled percentile on the first draw, then a controlled item choice. Search selection, recruitment filters and actual inventory mutations execute the supplied game DLL.

For manual search only, Time.deltaTime is 1, Component.get_gameObject, GameObject.SetActive and DialogueController.SetDialogue are harmless scene boundary stubs. UI rendering and Android execution are not tested.
